<\STATESEP>chapter "Access Rights"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory CapRights_A
imports Main
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype rights = AllowRead | AllowWrite | AllowGrant | AllowGrantReply<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "AllowSend \<equiv> AllowWrite"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "AllowRecv \<equiv> AllowRead"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  "CanModify \<equiv> AllowWrite"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cap_rights = "rights set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  all_rights :: cap_rights
where
 "all_rights \<equiv> UNIV"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
